name: ParetoGS Continuous-Budget Decoding
definition: A runtime procedure that returns parameters for exactly K Gaussians at any valid integer budget by interpolating between nested adapted anchors using a compressed residual atlas and calibrated exponents.
summary: ParetoGS Continuous-Budget Decoding is a runtime procedure that interpolates between nested anchors to return exactly K Gaussian parameters, enabling smooth quality-performance trade-offs without retraining.
